title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Strawberry Raspberry Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Raspberry Ice blends the sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the tart edge of Raspberry and a cool finish. The result is a balanced, fruity vape with a refreshing exhale that keeps it light and bright. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No refilling or coil replacements are necessary—simply attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. A dual mesh coil design ensures consistent vapour and flavour delivery for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
